title: Infosys Secures Landmark $1.5 Billion Generative AI Expansion Contract with Global Tier-1 Bank
text: Infosys (INFY) today announced an expanded strategic collaboration valued at over $1.5 billion over five years to provide generative AI-driven engineering and enterprise cloud modernization for a leading European financial institution. The agreement is expected to significantly boost operating margins and market share.
author: Economic Times Bureau

title: RBI Imposes Rs 2.5 Crore Penalty on HDFC Bank Over Digital Compliance Lapses
text: The Reserve Bank of India has issued an administrative penalty of Rs 2.5 crore on HDFC Bank for non-compliance with certain regulatory directions regarding digital banking infrastructure resiliency and reporting standards. Analysts note this may raise short-term compliance costs and draw regulatory scrutiny.
author: Reuters Finance

title: Reliance Industries Announces Mega 20 GW Solar Gigafactory Commissioning in Gujarat
text: Reliance Industries Ltd (RIL) chairman announced the early commissioning of its fully integrated 20 GW solar photovoltaic giga-complex in Jamnagar. Brokerages including Morgan Stanley and Goldman Sachs upgraded target prices, citing high future cash flow visibility in new energy.
author: Bloomberg Markets

title: Tata Consultancy Services (TCS) Reports 8.4% YoY Q3 Profit Growth, Beats Street Estimates
text: TCS delivered strong third-quarter results, driven by strong deal bookings worth $9.2 billion. Management highlighted accelerating discretionary IT spending and resilience in North American banking client accounts, declaring an interim dividend of Rs 28 per share.
author: Mint Markets

title: ICICI Bank Net NPA Drops to Multi-Year Low of 0.42%, Credit Growth Surges 16%
text: ICICI Bank showcased exceptional asset quality with gross non-performing assets moderating sharply. Domestic retail loan portfolio grew 16% year-on-year, reinforcing the bank's strong balance sheet profile and leadership in digital retail lending.
author: Financial Express

title: Bharti Airtel Faces Stiff Department of Telecom Notice on Adjusted Gross Revenue Dues
text: The Department of Telecommunications (DoT) has issued a fresh demand notice regarding recalculation of AGR dues totaling approximately Rs 3,400 crore against telecom operators including Bharti Airtel. Legal teams are preparing an immediate curative petition before the Supreme Court.
author: CNBC-TV18

title: State Bank of India (SBIN) Approves Raising Rs 10,000 Crore via Infrastructure Bonds
text: The executive committee of the State Bank of India central board has approved raising up to Rs 10,000 crore through long-term infrastructure bonds to fund affordable housing and public infrastructure credit pipelines at competitive coupon yields.
author: Business Standard

title: Larsen & Toubro Wins Major Rs 7,500 Crore High-Speed Rail Infrastructure Contract
text: L&T Heavy Civil Infrastructure business has secured a mega EPC contract from the National High Speed Rail Corporation for constructing viaducts and stations. This win expands L&T's consolidated order book beyond Rs 4.5 lakh crore.
author: ET Infrastructure
